g.card: Hindura aho imihanda ya gari ya moshi ihurira maze uyobore buri igare ry’ikirombe ku muryango wo gusohoka w’ibara ryaryo.
g.genre: Umukino w’ibisakuzo bya gari ya moshi n’amagare
g.desc: Gnome des Cavernes Enchantées: ibisakuzo 90 bya gari ya moshi mu buvumo 6 bwa kirisitali. Hindura imihanda maze uyobore buri igare ku muryango w’ibara ryaryo.
g.h2: Igisakuzo cya gari ya moshi mu buvumo bw’agakuru
g.p1: Amagare asohoka mu muyoboro akigendera ubwayo. Hindura imihanda kugira ngo buri rimwe rigere ku muryango w’ibara ryaryo nta kugongana.
g.p2: Ibyiciro 90 mu buvumo 6: imikoreshereze, ibiraro bizunguruka, urubura, amazi azamuka na lava. Bona inyenyeri 3 ukoresheje intambwe nke, kandi agakuru karagufasha iyo wafashwe.
l.card: Zunguruka indorerwamo, uyobore imirasire y’urumuri maze wongere ucane amazu 150 y’ingoro.
l.desc: Le Château des Lumières: zunguruka indorerwamo maze uyobore urumuri kuri kirisitali mu byiciro 150 n’isi 6 zishushanyije.
l.p1: Ingoro yazimye. Zunguruka indorerwamo n’amazu kugira ngo uyobore imirasire kuri kirisitali: iyo zose zimurika, urugi rwa zahabu rurafunguka.
l.p2: Ibyiciro 150 mu isi 6: amabara yo kuvanga, ibirahure by’amabara, purizime, ibishushanyo n’ingeri. Inama n’inyenyeri 3 kuri buri cyiciro ku bafite ubwenge kurusha.
d.card: Iruka, guruka kandi ucire umuriro mu bwami 7 bw’ubumaji n’abatware babwo 7.
d.desc: Le Petit Dragon: umukino w’urubuga wa 2D washushanyijwe n’intoki. Ambuka ubwami 7, ibyiciro 63 n’abatware 7 kugira ngo wirukane Umwami w’Igicucu.
d.p1: Kina nk’ikiyoka gito cy’icyatsi gifite ubutwari. Iruka, simbuka, guruka buhoro kandi ucire umuriro kugira ngo wirukane Umwami w’Igicucu.
d.p2: Ubwami 7, ibyiciro 63 n’abatware 7, buri wese afite amayeri ye. Kusanya kirisitali maze ubone kugeza ku nyenyeri 3 kuri buri cyiciro.
d.f2: Abatware 7 bo gutsinda, buri wese n’amayeri ye
t.card: Kata, zunguruka kandi ushyire ibicu kugira ngo ufungurire umudozi muto inzira.
t.desc: Le Tailleur de Nuages: ibisakuzo 240 mu turere 12 tw’ikirere. Kata, zunguruka kandi ushyire ibicu kugira ngo ufungure inzira.
t.p1: Ibirwa bireremba mu kirere kandi urugi rw’ubumaji rurategereje. Kata ibicu, ubizunguruke kandi ubishyire kugira ngo wubake inzira y’umudozi muto.
t.p2: Ibyiciro 240 mu turere 12 dushushanyije, nta saha. Bona inyenyeri 3, fungura amasanduku kandi ukusanye ibicu.
w.card: Shyira ingeri, ohereza ingufu maze ukangure ubwami bwasinziriye.
w.desc: Les Rouages Enchantés: ibisakuzo 150 by’imashini mu isi 6 z’imigani. Shyira ingeri maze wohereze ingufu kugira ngo imashini zongere gukora.
w.p1: Umuvumo wahagaritse ubwami. Shyira ingeri ahantu nyaho kugira ngo wohereze ingufu za moteri y’ubumaji kandi imashini zongere gukora.
w.p2: Ibyiciro 150 mu isi 6: inyuguti z’amayobera, imikoreshereze, imirasire ya kirisitali n’isaha y’umucanga. Bona inyenyeri 3 maze urebe amakarita agarura amabara yayo.
u.card: Shyira amabuye y’inyuguti z’amayobera agwa maze uhuze izifite ibara rimwe kugira ngo zibure.
u.desc: Royaume des Runes: shyira amabuye y’inyuguti z’amayobera agwa, uhuze amabara kandi uhuze kombo mu byiciro 180 n’uturere 6.
u.p1: Amabuye y’inyuguti agwa ku kibaho. Yimure kandi uyazunguruke kugira ngo uhuze inyuguti zifite ibara rimwe: zirabura kandi byose bikagwa hasi.
u.p2: Ibyiciro 180 mu turere 6, kuva ku Munara w’Umupfumu kugeza ku Kigo cyo mu Kirere. Huza kombo kugira ngo ubone inyenyeri 3.
n.card: Yobora ikiyoka, urye inyuguti z’amayobera kandi ukure utarumye umurizo wawe.
n.desc: Serpent des Runes: umukino w’inzoka ufite ikiyoka. Rya inyuguti, wirinde inzitizi kandi utsinde abarinzi 6 mu byiciro 120.
n.p1: Ikiyoka ntikigera gihagarara. Kurura urutoki kugira ngo ugihindukize, rya inyuguti kugira ngo ukure kandi wirinde inkuta n’umubiri wawe.
n.p2: Ibyiciro 120 mu turere 6, buri karere karindwa n’umutware. Inyuguti z’ubumaji zitinza igihe, zikakugira umuzimu cyangwa zikakurinda.
